title: CHAPTER 7 PREMISES OF DACOITY AND ROBBERY The cases registered under 'Dacoity' and 'Robbery' in the country were further analysed according to the place of occurrence of these two crimes. The highest number of Dacoity cases (10,801) were committed in residential premises and only four cases on 'Rivers and at Sea' were reported out of 14,590 total cases in 1981. The highest number of 'Robbery cases (7,859) were committed in residential premises, followed by 'Robbery on high-ways' (3.504) and only 18 cases of 'Robbery on Rivers and at Sea' and 19 cases of 'Robbery in Banks' were reported during 1981. In Delhi the majority of robberies were committed in residential premises followed by commercial establishments. The relevant statistics are set forth in Table-50 and 51.
